Subject: PO routing & vendor setup questions for marketplace listing

Hi Rishi,

We're moving fast on the AuroraAI integration and procurement asked me to confirm the exact steps to get a PO routed and the vendor set up for AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace listings. A few specific Qs: 

- Do you accept a consolidated PO that covers cross-cloud listing (single PO for AWS + GCP + Azure)?
- What payment terms do you normally accept? Our procurement prefers Net-45; can Redwood accommodate that or is Net-30 standard?
- Is there a vendor onboarding form we need to complete (tax ids, billing entity, contact info)?
- Who should the PO be addressed to / where should it be emailed?

We have a draft PO (attached) and would like to get this moving this week if possible. Also target go-live for the listing is May 3 — is that realistic from your side once paperwork is in?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Sasha Ivanov

Subject: Re: PO routing & vendor setup questions for marketplace listing

Hi Sasha — thanks for the clear list. Long answer short: yes, we can support multi-cloud listings on a single PO but we need the invoice/billing entity and tax docs to match the PO. Below is the minimal checklist to get vendor setup completed and the PO accepted: 

1) Complete Redwood marketplace onboarding form (I attached our standard workbook). We need: legal billing entity, billing address, TAX/VAT ID, remittance contact, and preferred billing email.
2) Provide the signed PO PDF and email it to billing@redwood.com (CC your procurement lead). For marketplace sales across AWS/GCP/Azure, indicate which marketplaces to list in the body of the PO.
3) Payment terms: our default is Net-30. Net-45 is possible but requires finance approval for deals > $50k. Ben is looped to confirm.
4) W-9 / VAT equivalent: if US entity, attach W-9; if EU, attach VAT registration. We cannot process invoicing without this.
5) Lead time: once paperwork is complete and the PO is accepted, marketplace listing typically takes 10 business days (tests + listing metadata). For a May 3 go-live, we should have forms + PO in by Apr 12.

Next steps: I attached the onboarding workbook and an onboarding PO template. Ben — can you confirm whether Net-45 approval path is straightforward for this account and any thresholds we should share? Vanessa — tagging you for any legal routing / DPA checklist (if needed).

I can schedule a 30-min intake call tomorrow or Friday to walk through the form if that helps.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Attach: Redwood_Marketplace_Onboarding_Form.xlsx; Aurora_PO_Template.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 11:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO routing & vendor setup questions for marketplace listing

Thanks for loop-in. A few finance clarifications for the buyer so we can avoid back-and-forth: 

- Correct billing entity on the PO must match the tax doc (W-9 for US, VAT reg for EU).
- Routing: email the PO to billing@redwood.com. If the PO contains special terms (custom SLAs, credits, or unusual payment schedules), please also copy contracts@redwood.com.
- Net-45: we can approve Net-45 for this account but need manager-level signoff for deals > $50k ARR/commit. If the PO is purely one-time for marketplace listing fees (rather than committed capacity), Net-30 is default.

I'll attach a short vendor doc indicating required fields we extract from the PO. If they can pre-populate the vendor name, remit-to address, tax id, contact name, and email in the PO body it speeds processing.

Ben Carter
Director, Finance Operations — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

- We'll email billing@redwood.com with PO + VAT; CCing our procurement alias.
